subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/historyBase.ts

M2_blob_existence_taken_as_evidence._note: Accepts a recovery whenever the path has ANY history once the local blob exists on the remote: the orphaned-blob case (a rejected push uploaded the local edit) would then overwrite a real local edit. H4 and the two orphan-blob conflicts of H11 build that input.

M3_no_existence_precheck._note: Without the git/blobs pre-check a real local edit walks the whole path history on every sync (cost, not correctness): H3 asserts no commit-list / contents request for a local edit.
M3_no_existence_precheck.from: await getBlobText(q.transport, q.owner, q.repo, localSha, q.baseURL);

M5_list_failure_propagates._note: A failing commit-list request must leave the conflict to the merge layer, never fail the sync (H6).

M7_walk_capped_at_two_versions._note: H7 and H9 are the axes whose matching version sits at index 2 of the path history. H11 reddens too: its two orphan-blob conflicts then end their walk with not-found after 2 versions, BEFORE their fair share runs out, so H11's 'not fully checked' warning is no longer issued.

M15_deleting_commit_ends_walk._note: A 404 at a commit that deleted the path must skip that commit, not end the walk (reviewer LOW, probe PE).
M15_deleting_commit_ends_walk.from: continue; // e.g. the commit that deleted the path — no version there

M16_rate_limit_read_as_not_found._note: A rate-limited commit-list read as an ordinary miss does not stop the pass: the next conflict probes again.
